title: Prime Minister highlights India’s readiness for BRICS 2026
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has highlighted India’s readiness for BRICS 2026. In a post on X, Shri Modi said; “All set for BRICS 2026! @BricsIndia2026”
All set for BRICS 2026! @BricsIndia2026 pic.twitter.com/nXqqoBmoAm — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 10, 2026
